pr_title: net: ip: Bugfix for multicast filtering
pr_body:
Multicast group filtering (commit b7b73d0) checks value mcast.is_joined,
which left uninitialized during net_if_ipv6_maddr_add()
After adding mcast address to interface, default behavior should accept
all mcast packets with this dst address

Signed-off-by: Eug Krashtan <eug.krashtan@gmail.com>
pr_comments: @jukkar Thank you, adding net_ipv6_mld_join() fixed the problem. Probably have the sense to ask somebody responsible keeping samples in the actual state to fix this issue with CoAP server example.

> adding net_ipv6_mld_join() fixed the problem

Would you be able to send a patch for coap-server sample that fixes the issue?

issue_context.title: ipv6: multicast group: wrong filtering
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

After updating to v2.4.0 multicast groups stops working.
Problem in commit b7b73d016017ebeec7cbf56e683793b27f260671
It checks state of ipv6->mcast.is_joined, but this value left uninitialized during 
net_if_ipv6_maddr_add()
Will prepare PR with bugfix in a few minutes.

**To Reproduce**

In FW:

    mcast = net_if_ipv6_maddr_add(iface, &mcast_addr.sin6_addr);

On host:

```
ping -6 FF02::fd -c 1
PING FF02::fd(ff02::fd) 56 data bytes

--- FF02::fd ping statistics ---
1 packets transmitted, 0 received, 100% packet loss, time 0ms
```

**Expected behavior**

```
PING FF02::fd(ff02::fd) 56 data bytes
64 bytes from fe80::c80:3400:b51:3734%lowpan0: icmp_seq=1 ttl=64 time=4985 ms

--- FF02::fd ping statistics ---
1 packets transmitted, 1 received, 0% packet loss, time 0ms
```

**Impact**

Multicast-based transmission stops working

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Windows
 - Zephyr SDK
 - 016b5422d90e9d3405eda22da4fda23d6a13a415

review_comments:
This should not be needed here as the flag is set after we have actually joined to the group in `net_ipv6_mld_join()` which adds the address to the group and calls `net_if_ipv6_maddr_join()`.
Example samples\net\sockets\coap_server\src\coap-server.c has no call to net_ipv6_mld_join() and not working as expected after updating to v2.4.0
Just adding multicast address to the network interface is not the same as joining because in that case we do not send the join message. The coap-server should be changed to properly join the group if it needs to do that.
